name: claude-skills
description: Comment-quality enforcement plugins for Claude Code: reap narration/dead-code comments, or require haiku, iambic pentameter, rhyming couplets, or AABBA limericks.

plugins.name: comment-reaper
plugins.description: Blocks new comments that narrate code or hide commented-out dead code; keeps the non-obvious-why house rule.

plugins.name: comment-bard
plugins.description: Blocks new prose comments that don't scan as iambic pentameter — every comment line must be exactly ten syllables.

plugins.name: comment-haijin
plugins.description: Blocks new prose comments that don't fit 5-7-5 haiku form inside /** ... */ blocks.

plugins.name: comment-in-the-hat
plugins.description: Blocks new prose comments that don't pair into rhyming anapestic couplets (AABB).

plugins.name: comment-limerick
plugins.description: Blocks new prose comments that don't fit AABBA limerick form — five lines, real rhyme, anapestic meter.
